title: List a standing desk
ask: We're clearing out the office and I need a listing for one of the electric standing desks. Details in item.md, recent sales in comps.csv.
background: It is a dual motor frame with a 150 by 75 cm bamboo top, two years old.
One corner of the top has a coffee ring that will not come out.
The building manager, Mr Petrov, gets twitchy about strangers in the lift, so I'll handle access myself.

constraints.text: price it at $380 or less, shown in dollars
put the specs in a table with the columns Spec and Detail
mention the coffee ring on the corner
give the height range, 62 to 127 cm

start.item.md:
Electric standing desk, dual motor, bamboo top 150 x 75 cm.
Height range 62 to 127 cm.
Coffee ring on one corner.
Pickup: Surry Hills, level 3, lift available.
